name: Desalination plant

real.plant: Claude "Bud" Lewis Carlsbad Desalination Plant, California (Poseidon Water)
real.basis: Carlsbad delivers nearly 50 million US gallons of fresh water a day, 189300 m3 or 7886 t an hour, with a staff of about 40 working full time (WWD plant profile, 2020); its design energy use of 246,000 MWh a year is 28.06 MW on average; it draws sea water, so no fresh water

bpBasis: The Carlsbad seawater desalination plant cost $1 billion, completed in 2015

name: Gas field

real.plant: Ormen Lange gas field, Norwegian Sea (A/S Norske Shell)
real.basis: Ormen Lange sold 7.608 billion Sm3 of gas in 2024 (Norwegian Offshore Directorate fact pages), 5.592 Mt at the Energy Institute's 0.735 million tonnes of LNG a billion m3 (Statistical Review of World Energy 2025, conversion factors); its staff, power and water are not published

bpBasis: Investment in Ormen Lange to the end of 2024 was NOK 63,467 million in nominal terms (Norsk Petroleum), $5.91 billion at Norges Bank's 2024 average of 10.7433 kroner a dollar; it includes the later phases

name: Oil field

real.plant: Johan Sverdrup oil field, North Sea (Equinor)
real.basis: Johan Sverdrup produces 755,000 barrels of oil a day since its second phase (Equinor, 2022), 103000 t a day at the Energy Institute's 7.33 barrels a tonne (Statistical Review of World Energy 2025), and is powered from shore through 300 MW of capacity for both phases (Equinor, 2018), the capacity standing for its demand; its staff and fresh water are not published

bpBasis: Phase 1 of Johan Sverdrup cost NOK 83 billion (Equinor, 2019) and phase 2 NOK 48 billion (Equinor, 2022), $9.43 billion and $4.99 billion at Norges Bank's averages of 8.8037 and 9.6245 kroner a dollar for 2019 and 2022

real.plant: Shute Creek gas processing and helium plant, LaBarge, Wyoming (ExxonMobil)
real.basis: Shute Creek can produce as much as 1.4 billion cubic feet of helium a year (Center for Land Use Interpretation), 6570 t at USGS's 27.737 m3 for 1,000 cubic feet and NIST's 0.1692 kg a m3 at 15 C and one atmosphere; ExxonMobil employs about 200 workers and 100 long-term contractors for helium operations (Cowboy State Daily, 2024); its 125 MW cogeneration plant (Industrial Info) stands for its demand, which covers the whole gas plant; its water is not published

name: Ethylene cracker

real.plant: Shell Polymers Monaca ethane cracker, Pennsylvania (Shell)
real.basis: Shell's Monaca complex makes 1.5 million t of ethylene a year and feeds 1.6 million t of polyethylene, with a 250 MW gas-fired cogeneration unit (Oil & Gas Journal, 2022), the unit's capacity standing for its demand; it employs more than 600 full-time; its water use is not published

bpBasis: Shell decided in 2016 to build the Monaca ethane cracker complex for about $6 billion, its polyethylene units included; no final cost is published

name: Sulfur recovery plant

real.plant: Shah sour gas plant and its sulfur recovery units, Al Dhafra, Abu Dhabi (Al Hosn Gas)
real.basis: The Shah sour gas development is to yield 9,900 t of sulfur granules a day; it produced 2 million t in its first year, 2015 (NS Energy, 2016); its staff, power and water are not published

bpBasis: ADNOC inaugurated the Al Hosn sour gas project, with its wells, gas plant, sulfur recovery and pipelines, at $10 billion (2016)

real.plant: Nueva Victoria caliche mine and iodine plants, Tarapacá, Chile (SQM)
real.basis: Nueva Victoria has a capacity of 13 kt of iodine a year and needs an estimated 1,519 workers; its electricity in 2025 was about 16 MW, and it drew 20,260,752 m3 of industrial water, 2311 t an hour (SQM technical report summary, 2026); the same caliche yields nitrate salts, which these figures include

real.plant: Pilgangoora spodumene operation, Pilbara, Western Australia (PLS Group)
real.basis: Pilgangoora produced 879,543 dmt of spodumene concentrate at 5.3% Li2O in its year to June 2026, 21660 t of lithium at 46.5% lithium in Li2O, and took in 4.5 GL of water, 513 t an hour, some of it brackish; PLS has 1,092 employees in Australia, its Perth office included (PLS annual report 2026); its power is not published

Rocanville produced 5.015 Mt of finished potash at 60.49% K2O in 2024, 2.518 Mt of potassium at 83.0% potassium in K2O, and draws 112 MVA of high-voltage power, taken as 112 MW (NI 43-101 technical report, 2025); Mining Technology lists 340 employees; its water is not published

real.plant: Four Corners phosphate mine and beneficiation plant, Florida (Mosaic)
real.basis: Four Corners produced 7.013 Mt of phosphate rock at 28.4% P2O5 in 2021, 0.8692 Mt of phosphorus at 43.6% phosphorus in P2O5, on 852,423,065 kWh of electricity, 97.24 MW on average, and 5.831 million m3 of deep well water, 665.2 t an hour (Mosaic technical report summary, 2023), with 510 employees and no contractors (fact sheet, 2021)

real.plant: Goderich rock salt mine, Ontario (Compass Minerals)
real.basis: Goderich produces an average of 6.5 million short tons of salt a year at 98.17% NaCl, 2.277 Mt of sodium at 39.3% sodium in NaCl, with a headcount of 530, 74,998,668 kWh of electricity, 8.56 MW on average, and about 31,700 US gallons of town water a day, 5 t an hour, in 2021 (technical report summary, 2022)

real.plant: Boron open pit mine and refinery, Kern County, California (Rio Tinto)
real.basis: Rio Tinto's Boron operation produced 502 kt of borates as B2O3 in 2025 (Rio Tinto 20-F for 2025), 155.9 kt of boron at 31.1% boron in B2O3; its staff, power and water are not published

real.plant: Marulan South limestone mine, New South Wales (Boral)
real.basis: Marulan South mined 2,428,400 t of limestone in 2023/2024 with about 95 full-time personnel and took 91.7 ML of river and ground water, 10.5 t an hour (Boral annual review 2023/2024); its calcium is taken at the 40.0% calcium of pure CaCO3, since no grade is published; its power is not published
